The 1981–82 [[Czechoslovak First League]] was contested by 16 teams, and [[Dukla Prague]] won the championship. [[Peter Herda]] and [[Ladislav Vízek]] were the league's top scorers with 15 goals each.<ref>{{cite book|first=Luboš|last=Jeřábek|title=Český a československý fotbal - lexikon osobností a klubů|publisher=Grada Publishing|language=Czech|year=2007|location=Prague, Czech Republic|isbn=978-80-247-1656-5|page=232}}</ref>
